entities.summary: The Madrasa of Uljay al-Yusufi is a mosque and historic monument in the al-Darb al-Ahmar neighbourhood of Cairo, Egypt. Originally a madrasa, it was built during the reign of the Mamluk sultan Al-Ashraf Sha'ban.
